ruling.explanation:
This is a route-deviation dispute over a SGD 9.70 metered fare. Both sides' surviving claims agree on the substance, and the arithmetic is as follows.

Deviation established (POL-RD-01). The governing distance is the GPS trace, not the rounded trip-record copy. trace_distance_km = 4.04 km (EV-GPS-02844) against optimal_distance_km = 3.2 km (EV-TRIP-02844) gives an excess of 0.84 km, which is 26.25% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass — the excess exceeds 20% of optimal and exceeds 0.8 km in absolute terms. The trace figure is essential here: trip_record.actual_distance_km is 4.0 km, which would give exactly 0.8 km and fail the absolute limb, so the trace is the only safe basis for the finding.

Trace integrity (POL-RD-07). The trace is NOT impaired for policy purposes: 46 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0. None of limbs (a) to (c) fires, so the deviation stands on the trace alone, no independent corroboration is required under POL-RD-07(ii), and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises.

The driver's explanation. The only driver explanation on file is the counterparty statement 'One-way streets.' No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02844-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and the note that no advisory covers the Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 corridor in this window. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against this trip's traffic_advisory and nothing else; with no advisory on file that comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver named no advisory identifier, this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged and no escalation follows.

Driver-side exculpations (POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-12). The chat log (EV-CHAT-02844) carries 0 messages with null timestamps, so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint to test; pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. No part of the excess is excluded.

Refund (POL-RD-02). The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs rather than POL-RD-11. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 3.2 km + 0.28 × 6.0 min) × 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 fixed surcharges + 0.00 waiting time − 0.00 promo = 8.68. Refund = charged_total 9.70 − recomputed_fare 8.68 = 1.02, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 1.05. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and far below the 90% full-refund share (8.73), so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 1.05.

Pass-throughs (POL-RD-09). The fare breakdown carries no ERP lines (on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route totals both 0.00) and no airport surcharge, on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. There is nothing to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure and no billing-integrity finding, so no POL-RD-09(4) referral.

Profiles (POL-RD-06, POL-RD-08, POL-GEN-01). The deviation is 26.25%, above the establishment threshold but below the 50% material threshold, so it is not a MATERIAL deviation and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. No repeat-deviation pattern exists in any event: deviation_flags_90d = 1 against completed_trips_90d = 247, a ratio of 0.004, below both the 3-flag and 0.05 limbs. (One rider submission gave completed_trips_90d as 82; 82 is the 30-day figure on EV-DPROF-02844 — the 90-day figure is 247, and the pattern test fails on either figure, so nothing turns on the slip.) The rider's citable counters, deviation_claims_60d and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated, are both 0, so the POL-RD-08 corroboration overlay is not engaged. No profile field was used as a ground of decision.

Confidence and escalation. The deciding facts — the trace distance, the optimal distance and the fare figures — are carried by EV-GPS-02844, EV-TRIP-02844 and EV-FARE-02844, each at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.95. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: identifiers all match TRP-02844, timestamps agree, the trace is policy-clean, no cited exculpatory artifact is missing, the refund is far below SGD 150.00 and below charged_total, and no charge line lacks a counterpart.

Execution and appeal. The monetary effect, SGD 1.05, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes automatically on issue. Either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
